sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) The National Assembly may establish various committees as it considers appropriate for the effective exercise of its powers. (2) The Standing Orders may prescribe the composition and functions of committees of the National Assembly established under this Article.
vifungu: (1) The National Assembly may establish various committees as it considers appropriate for the effective exercise of its powers.
(2) The Standing Orders may prescribe the composition and functions of committees of the National Assembly established under this Article.
